card.name: Lower end of a reported range
card.fires_on: The first number (or the space before it) right after "range" in parentheses, giving the lowest value of a span like "range 1 to 260 days". It occurs after a median or mean time or duration in clinical trial results.

modes.label: Low number after range
modes.description: The starting number of a range given after a median time to onset or duration.
modes.example: The malignancies occurred after a median of 30 months of therapy (range <<1>> to 84 months).

modes.label: Space after range colon
modes.description: The space just before the first number in a range, after "range" or "range:".
modes.example: The median time to first onset was 3 days (range:<< >>1 to 260 days).

card.writes: It pushes toward a "to" and an upper limit, and away from words like negative or the signs ≥ and "greater than".
card.plain: It marks the spot where the smallest value of a range, such as "range 1 to 84 months", is written after a median time.
